title: Bag of Bricks - White 37
descriptionHtml:
White — colour 37

The brightest point in the palette, and the one that makes a portrait come alive. Catchlights in the eyes, teeth, snow, clouds — small quantities, enormous effect.

Works well with: Cream 20, Stone Grey 36, Black 01

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: White bricks (colour 37) for Memobrick mosaics. The brightest highlight in the palette, essential for eyes, teeth and snow detail.
